name: Akainacephalus
sum: Akainacephalus is an ankylosaurid from the Kaiparowits Formation of Utah, the most complete ankylosaur known from southern Laramidia.
holotype: UMNH VP 20202, a skull, mandibles, vertebrae, ribs, a complete tail club, limb bones and osteoderms — Horse Mountain Gryposaur Quarry, Kaiparowits Formation, Utah.
material: Holotype only, from a multitaxic bonebed.
biology: Thorny head ornamentation gives the genus its name; the tail club is complete.
author: Wiersma and Irmis 2018
